A CONTRIBUTING FACTOR TO THE OVER-TIGHTENED CONNECTION MAY BE THE MECHANICS/HAND PLACEMENT DURING INFUSION ACCESS. IT IS PREFERABLE TO GRASP THE NEEDLELESS CONNECTOR (NC) WHEN CONNECTING A SYRINGE/TUBING TO IT RATHER THAN GRASPING THE PASV VALVE LUER HUB WHILE MAKING A CONNECTION WITH THE NC. GRASPING THE PASV VALVE HUB WHILE CONNECTING A SYRINGE/TUBING SET TO THE NC CAN TRANSMIT ADDITIONAL TORQUE TO THE PASV FEMALE LUER HUB. INADEQUATE FLUSHING OF THE DEVICE LUMEN MAY ALSO BE A CONTRIBUTING FACTOR.
